EXAMPLE DATA · fictitious patients (Eva Holmgren, Lars Nyström), plausible values
“*” = invented encounter/template · “Synthetic nn” = synthetic patients

V7 (English) · Collapsible three-layer stack: clustered ontology DAG · archetypes over templates · content-sized cascaded instance treemaps

Top (locked): Sugiyama DAG per code system; intermediate SNOMED CT concepts are grouped into clusters (+n = hidden concepts; click to expand). Click the coloured background of an expanded cluster, not a node or an edge, to collapse it again; a drag does not. Labels show on hover. Middle: click an archetype or template to open it as a treemap of its nodes and elements (from the IPS OPT, CKM 1013.26.376). Bottom: click any card to shrink a patient, composition or subtree to a blob. Collapsed things get bundled links with counts; expanded things split them into dotted element-level links.
Patients:
━ n bundled links (count) · ┄ element-level link between expanded nodes · hatched tile = value coded with a terminology · hover anything to trace its path · coloured cluster background: click empty space to collapse
